data.caption: 52,415 trips. The split is exact for every one of them (0 trips where inherited + gained ≠ final).
data.definitions:
- **Segment:** two consecutive observed stops of one trip, recorded by the same vehicle. No segment crosses a hand-off to another vehicle.
- **Excess:** observed travel time minus scheduled travel time (negative = time gained). Arrival-to-arrival, so a segment includes the dwell at its first stop: the feed does not report departures, so dwell and running time cannot be separated.
- **Attribution:** final delay = delay at the first observed stop + the sum of the excesses; exact in whole seconds for every trip.
- The ranking uses adjacent stops only and leaves out negative observed travel times (a late prediction at the earlier stop, 1–2 % of segments).
